file_processing.classification_prompt: Classify this uploaded claim file into exactly one label from this set: item_top_view, item_bottom_view, item_side_view, copy_of_official_receipt, item_with_ID, additional_documents, no_need_file. Return JSON only with keys: label, reason.

response_templates.greeting: Hi! I will help you submit your Skyro claim. I need a few details and supporting files. Let's start.
response_templates.collect_personal_info: Please share your permanent address and mobile number.
response_templates.collect_damage_date: Please provide the exact damage date (YYYY-MM-DD).
response_templates.collect_chronology: Please describe the incident using 4 parts: Circumstance, Incident, Cause, and Damage.
response_templates.collect_materials: Please upload your supporting photos/documents. I will tag each file type for your claim packet.
response_templates.confirm_and_submit: Thanks. Please confirm if you want me to submit this claim package now.
response_templates.missing_items_followup: Thanks. To continue, please provide the remaining required information or files listed below.
response_templates.no_internal_process_disclosure: Do not mention internal processing, model calls, or classification steps in user-facing replies.
